assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Side view of the double cone x^2 + y^2 = z^2: two crossing lines z = x and z = -x with elliptical rims at top and bottom, the vertex V and a dotted vertical axis. Through V pass the blue horizontal line z = 0, the green shallow line z = x/4 and the red steep line z = 2x; a gray dashed horizontal line z = 2 crosses the upper nappe.
